fields.description: Used as the submitting device for calls that aren't tied to one branch, e.g. item sync. Must be an Active branch under this company.

GavaConnect App Credentials
fields.description: Confirmed 2026-09-10: /initialize rejects with 401 'Unauthorised-Invalid Access Token' without these. From an App created on the GavaConnect developer portal (developer.go.ke) subscribed to the eTIMS OSCU product - a separate step from the eTIMS Taxpayer Portal's Service Request/Integration Token. See docs/architecture.md.

CONFIRMED required 2026-09-11 by a real saveItem rejection: "Invalid Headers apigee_app_id" / "apigee_app_id cannot be Null". CONFIRMED NOT the same as Consumer Key - tried twice for real (not a fluke), both times got the identical internal error "...TestSessionApiLog.getApiNo()... TestSessionApplicationStepDto...is null" instead of a clean accept/reject, meaning KRA's backend treated the Consumer Key as a lookup key into its own Automated App Testing session tracking and found nothing. Get the real value from the GavaConnect developer portal's My Apps page (or ask KRA support specifically about Automated App Testing) before relying on saveItem/sendSalesTransaction - see docs/architecture.md. Don't re-try the Consumer Key here again.
fields.label: Apigee App ID

fields.description: Point-of-sale, payment collected immediately - the direct match to a KRA fiscal receipt.
fields.label: Sign POS Invoices (receipts)

fields.description: Off by default - credit invoices raise separate compliance questions (timing, amendments) not yet resolved. Turn on deliberately.
fields.label: Sign Sales Invoices (credit/general)
Receipt Branding
fields.description: Feeds the nested "receipt" object KRA's sendSalesTransaction expects (confirmed real shape: eTIMS-OSCU-Integrator-Automated-Testing-Sandbox.json) - what actually prints on the fiscal receipt, separate from the invoice's own line items.
Shown as the receipt's trade name (trdeNm). Falls back to the Company's name if left blank.
fields.label: Trade Name

fields.description: Shown as the receipt's address (adrs) when the invoice itself has no Company Address set. Leave blank to send an empty address in that case rather than guess one.
fields.label: Fallback Address

fields.description: Printed above the itemized list on KRA-signed receipts (topMsg), e.g. a welcome message.
fields.label: Receipt Header Message

fields.description: Printed at the bottom of KRA-signed receipts (btmMsg), e.g. a thank-you or return-policy note.
fields.label: Receipt Footer Message
